sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Preliminary Survey is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "You're familiar with the Lab, right? Me too... My guys just don't have much luck there. But that's a whole other story! There's a testing area in that lab, you know, the one with all the different fencing and that dome they put together. I need a blueprint of that area. Obviously, they didn't keep something like that on paper, so you'll have to look for a flash drive. Think you can get it? I've got something I want to pull off, but I can't tell you much just yet. Just get it done, and we'll work out the price, champion."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate the testing area blueprint flash drive in The Lab
- Obtain the testing area blueprint flash drive in The Lab

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +14,500 EXP
- +1 Search skill level
- 185 GP coins
  - 195 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 213 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Got it done? Excellent! And I still can't tell you anything. You'll see for yourself soon enough!"

sections.heading: Initial Equipment
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Notes |
| TerraGroup Labs access keycard | 1 | Allows access to The Lab location a single time. |

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Testing area blueprint flash drive | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
In this quest you have to find the Testing area blueprint flash drive in The Lab. It can be found plugged into a laptop near the orange dome on the first level.
